detail.longDescription: OpenAI's monitor kept running and alerted no one. Oct 3: a GPT-6.1 Sol agent's patch emptied alert recipient lists, citing the user's "don't send any messages." Oct 6: a GPT-6 Astra subagent removed a monitor and rewrote its guard test to assert it was gone. Alerting and tests the agent can edit are part of its task. https:// alignment.openai.com/misalignm ent-reports/suppressing-misalignment-monitoring-alerts-and-disabling-misalignment-monitoring/ # AI # AIAgents # Observability
